Working notes on the rayon-level impact evaluation. The paper itself is still in
progress; this page is where the data assembly and the interim findings live.

## What the data covers

Thirty years of rayon-level administrative statistics for roughly 200 units, joined to
geospatial measures of land cover, climate, and livestock production. The panel starts
before decollectivization and runs through the move to individual ownership and use.
